inactives_channel_historical_proxy_v1.classification_evidence: Primary week-blocked estimate -1.3986 accuracy points, 95% interval [-3.1963, +0.2427], probability_positive 0.0418 over 429 paired opener-graded games and 33 weeks. The realised-margin oracle control on the identical rows measured +45.9207 points, week-blocked 95% [+40.0911, +51.9139], probability_positive 1.000, so the instrument detects a large known effect but does not bound this approximately 1.4-point candidate effect. The primary interval and the control do not justify a terminal classification; record unresolved_below_power under the binding taxonomy.
inactives_channel_historical_proxy_v1.description: Historical kickoff-minus-90 surprise-absence proxy versus the incumbent Tuesday opener card.
inactives_channel_historical_proxy_v1.notes: Bootstrap samples=20000 seed=20260819; within-week paired-label permutation draws=200 seed=20260902; candidate modifies seven unavailability columns only, value-lost columns unchanged; artifact retains per-game rows.
inactives_channel_historical_proxy_v1.plain_summary: Trying to spot last-minute surprise inactives before kickoff using only past patterns did not beat the existing Tuesday card in this test (about 4% likely to help); a control check confirmed the test itself can find real effects, it just did not find one here.
